title: Sufi imam: jinn change physical scripture but not memory

tellings.quote: there was this one Sufi Imam who claimed that the reason why even after the introduction of writing and writing down the Quran that it's still memorized word for word is that there are these entities out there who don't live in normal space and time the way we do. They can go back and change physical objects but they're not allowed to change our memory

plain: A Sufi imam is said to have explained why the Quran is still memorized word for word even though it has long been written down: there are beings, which the story calls jinn, "who don't live in normal space and time the way we do" and who "can go back and change physical objects but they're not allowed to change our memory." Rizwan Virk, introduced on the show as an MIT scientist, passes on this claim from an imam he does not name. Taken seriously, it would make memory a safer keeper of scripture than any written copy.
